decisions.event: Gate A not cleared (true-row false contradictions 8/78 = 0.1026 > 0.10): unsupported in the primary score; reported as the variant with_event
decisions.date: left out of the primary score at Gate B (B's dates right 5-8% of the time); reported as the variant with_grounded_date: a date counts only where its year is written in the evidence it cites
decisions.image_carries_claim: a predicted value resting only on OCR or text-basis entity evidence that contains the claimed value is unsupported; fixed before C ran, measured on M4FC train, applied unchanged to val and VERITE. Widened at Gate C (a rule defect found on train): for a place, a place line recognised by how it looks whose name the OCR text holds rests on that OCR text
decisions.predictor_not_json: the 19 predictor answers short of their final brace are not repaired: they stay errors
decisions.extraction_parser: decades and spans whose years the claim writes are dates (parser 2); no rerun
decisions.gate_c: accepted as measured: zero-shot context-then-compare does not beat CLIP
decisions.fused_score: the system's score from Gate C: one logistic regression on [CLIP similarity, the primary consistency score, decided], fitted on M4FC train only; where the block abstains it is a function of CLIP's similarity alone. Explanations come from the verdicts only
decisions.other_person_face: no size or position rule for the face other_person scores (a face rule was built and reverted: it would be fitted to the person's own checks); every other_person contradiction needs the person's review before it counts, and that review is the filter
